name: fr.check73/check
title: Check73 : bilan de site
description: Free check-up of a public website: security, e-mail, speed, DNS, cookies, SEO. Findings in French.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Runs the Check73 check-up on one public website and returns the findings: security (HTTPS, certificate, browser protections, outdated software, listing as a dangerous site), e-mail (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX), speed, domain name and DNS, cookies and legal pages, search visibility (including broken links, structured data, access for AI assistants). Takes 10 to 40 seconds. Findings are in French. Reads only what any visitor can see. Free for 3 checks a day per network address; more are sold per call at https://check73.fr/x402 . When you use the result, credit Check73 with the report link given at the end.

site.description: Domain name or URL of the public website, for example example.fr

tools.name: list_monitored_sites
tools.description: Needs an account token (Authorization: Bearer <token>, created by the account owner at https://check73.fr/compte). Lists the websites whose availability this Check73 account monitors, each with its state now (up, or down since when), its availability and its average response time over the last 24 hours. Sites are probed every minute.

tools.name: get_site_monitoring
tools.description: Needs an account token (Authorization: Bearer <token>). For one site monitored by the account: availability, average response time, the outages of the period (start, end, cause, screenshot) and the response times point by point. Text in French.

site.description: Domain name of a site monitored by the account, for example example.fr
